When this engine fires, partner-eating dynamics dominate. Shared cuisine choices, joint-restaurant patterns. Honor your own body-signal even in shared settings.

When this engine fires, run a precision food-audit. Track three meals a day for two weeks; the body will tell you exactly what irritates. Eliminate the obvious — alcohol, refined sugar, fried, late-night — and reintroduce one at a time.
When this engine fires, snack-discipline matters. Pre-prep clean small bites; the small-burst hunger will arrive — meet it cleanly. Sibling-channel meals comfort.
When this engine fires, regularity is the medicine. Same meals at same times for two weeks; the system stabilizes. Warm cooked food, steady protein, oils and warming spices for joints.
When this engine fires, the home kitchen is the answer. Mother's recipes restore; family-table meals are medicinal; the cooking pot itself heals.

When this engine fires, the body wants beauty in food — well-presented, fragrant, sensual eating. Slow meals, candlelit dinners, well-curated plates. The shadow: aesthetic-eating that focuses on form over the body's real signal.

display_name: Venus ruler of the 1st House in the 1st House
description: Your constitution is Kapha-rich. Body holds reserves easily; weight settles in the hips, chest, lower belly; skin glows when nourished and dulls when neglected. Sweet tooth runs deep; dairy and refined-grain pleasure can quietly thicken the body. The diet that suits you is warm, lightly spiced, slightly bitter and astringent: bitter greens, ginger, turmeric, black pepper, mustard, basmati rice, lentil dal, small amounts of ghee, cooked fruit. Avoid cold dairy, ice cream, heavy desserts, oily fried, late-night feasting. Move daily; the body holds without movement.

display_name: Venus ruler of the 6th House in the 1st House
description: Daily friction with food shows on the body — the skin, the gut, the joints register every misstep. The body is a precise instrument of feedback. Use it: when the skin breaks out, when sleep gets disturbed, when joints stiffen, audit the last three days of eating and find the trigger. The shadow: comfort-eating that masks the conflict instead of resolving it.

display_name: Saturn ruler of the 10th House in the 10th House
description: Structural eating-rhythm is the long-game medicine. Build a fixed meal-schedule and the metabolism compounds. Joints, bones, knees need warm, oily, well-spiced food in middle age. Bone broth, sesame, ghee, ginger, turmeric — long-game nourishment. Avoid raw cold salads as the primary diet; favor soups, stews, well-cooked vegetables.

display_name: Saturn ruler of the 9th House in the 10th House
description: Diet must align with dharma. Sattvic, traditional, ceremonial food works best long-arc. Saturn-Aquarian discipline favors a fixed, simple, repeatable food system — same meals at same times for years compound into excellent health.

display_name: Jupiter ruler of the 11th House in the 11th House
description: Generous appetite. You can eat large portions of rich, traditional food and feel blessed by it — but the body remembers. Weight gain is gradual and structural rather than rapid. Group-meals, ceremonial-feasts, sattvic banquets favor you in moderation. Best practice: largest meal at midday; lighter dinner; no late food. Foreign-cuisine fascination compounds; international travel-eating is medicinal.

display_name: Jupiter ruler of the 8th House in the 11th House
description: Sudden food-shifts (allergies, intolerances, deep dietary epiphanies) arrive through the wide-network and friend-circle. The community-cleanse, the friend-led elimination diet, the international-cuisine immersion that resets the gut. Inheritance of food-traditions through extended family. The shadow: trend-diet pressure from the network — verify each protocol against your body's actual response.

display_name: Moon ruler of the 3rd House in the 3rd House
description: Emotion goes through small-burst eating. Stress shows up as snacking, courage shows up as appetite-clarity. Build a clean snack system; pre-prep simple bites; the urge will be honored without breaking the body. Sibling-channel meals (siblings, cousins, peer-friends) carry comfort-charge — eat with them often.

display_name: Sun ruler of the 4th House in the 4th House
description: Home-kitchen is the throne. Mother's recipes, traditional family dishes, the dining table you grew up at — all medicinal. The home cookpot beats every restaurant. Build a kitchen that feels royal: good cookware, ample light, ceremonial-quality plates. Best foods: warm cooked rice, ghee in moderation, dal, vegetables, seasonal traditional dishes. Eat the largest meal at midday at home.

display_name: Mercury ruler of the 2nd House in the 5th House
description: Speech, family-finance, and food intersect in a creative-analytic key. You think clearly about food when you treat the diet as a curated project — meal plans, journals, recipe rotations. Earn through food-content, recipe-writing, food-photography, beverage-craft if it ever appeals. The shadow: over-thinking food into a performance — the body wants the simple bowl more than the styled plate.

display_name: Mercury ruler of the 5th House in the 5th House
description: Mercury exalted on the digestive-creative engine. The mind reads the body precisely when given the chance — keep a food journal for two weeks and the system will tell you exactly what irritates and what nourishes. Best foods: lightly cooked greens, basmati, lentils, fresh fruit, ginger, fennel, coriander. Avoid: heavy creams, refined sugar, fried, late-night.

display_name: Mars ruler of the 12th House in the 7th House
description: Foreign or hidden food-exposures shape the gut. Travel-eating, retreat-meals, hospital diets, hotel breakfasts shift the system. The shadow: indulgent shared-eating during travel that thickens the body silently — schedule a clean-eating reset day weekly.

display_name: Mars ruler of the 7th House in the 7th House

The partner's food-mood often colors yours; the kitchen you share is the most influential nutrition factor of the long marriage. The shadow: outsourcing the food agenda to the partner — keep your own diet-plumb-line.
